propositions: A cancelled or timed-out mutation job casts Verified -1 with message 'CANCELLED: <url>' that names no job and gives no reason, making triage require manual inspection of the run.
The gerrit-review-action self-builds its message and exposes no input for custom text, so detail cannot be enriched in the vote label itself.

Two distinct failure causes (timeout at 30m and version-skew invalid-choice error) produce identical uninformative 'CANCELLED' votes, preventing agents from distinguishing whether author action (rebase) is needed.

The solution posts a detailed triage comment via dedicated SSH 'gerrit review --message' (no --label) after the vote is cast, carrying job names, outcomes (TIMED OUT / CANCELLED / FAILED), and durations.

The summarizer fetches jobs from actions/runs/<id>/jobs and per-job annotations from check-runs/<id>/annotations, requiring checks: read permission and best-effort degradation on annotation fetch failure.
Both new workflow steps are continue-on-error and ordered after the vote cast, ensuring the label is already on the change before comment delivery and preventing faults from reddening the run.
